description: ARRAY_CONTAINS / ARRAY_REMOVE match numeric members by VALUE, whatever the element node and the search value are (int, long or double) - a strict node-equality misses them. The needle's type matters: live-verified on a real account, it must be VARIANT-coercible and a VARCHAR is NOT, so ARRAY_CONTAINS('b', [...]) fails with "Invalid argument types for function 'ARRAY_CONTAINS': (VARCHAR(1), ARRAY)" (as do a DATE and a BINARY needle) while a NUMBER, a BOOLEAN and an explicit ::VARIANT all work. Converted 1:1 from functions/ArrayContainsNumericTest (now retired); the ARRAY_REMOVE result is read through TO_JSON so the assertion is on the array's JSON text rather than on a transport's own rendering of an ARRAY cell.

steps.sql: SELECT ARRAY_CONTAINS(2, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT(1, 2, 3)), ARRAY_CONTAINS(1, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT(1, 2, 3)), ARRAY_CONTAINS(3, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT(1, 2, 3))
